summary: AS FISKETURER PÅ ROMSDALSFJORDEN (org. no. 917 008 973) is a private limited company (AS) based in Rauma, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-04-14. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 93.291 (Opplevelsesaktiviteter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 400 and net income was -NOK 23 919. Board chair: Peter Morgan Mårtensson.
